title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-09-11
headline: Sardine shortage hits shelves as Gen Z demand rises and catches shrink

questions.prompt: Who is helping drive higher demand for tinned sardines?
choices: Gen Z shoppers and social media food trends
questions.hintKo: Younger shoppers and social media trends are boosting sardine demand.

questions.prompt: What nutrients make sardines popular when they are available?
choices: Protein, omega-three fats, vitamin B twelve, and minerals
questions.hintKo: Sardines are valued for nutrients, not rocket or physics terms.

questions.prompt: When do shelves often look empty according to the reports?
choices: Now, as demand rises while catches shrink
questions.hintKo: Empty shelves are a current supply-demand problem, not ancient history.

questions.prompt: Where might shoppers notice the sardine shortage first?
choices: On grocery store shelves where tins used to sit
questions.hintKo: The shortage shows up at retail shelves, not labs or launch pads.

questions.prompt: Why can higher demand make sardines harder to find?
choices: Wild catches are shrinking while more people want the tins
questions.hintKo: Shrinking catches plus higher demand create shortages.

questions.prompt: How are some cooks responding when sardine tins vanish?
choices: They substitute mackerel, anchovies, or fresh fish
questions.hintKo: Cooks substitute other fish when sardine tins are unavailable.
